title: 第5章 这就没了第6章 天赋神通
slug: 灵气复苏我有个吞噬系统
content_zh:
随着系统的声音落下。
玄冰蛇的尸体的气势瞬间就弱了下去，鳞片也变得暗淡无光。
“队长，这玄冰蛇……好像有古怪，一身精华散的差不多了。”
叶成走过去检查玄冰蛇的尸体，发现了玄冰蛇尸体的异常，开口道。
魔兽的身躯可是能卖出好价钱的，甚至一些魔兽体内还会孕育出魔核，更加珍贵。
但是眼下这只魔兽玄冰蛇的尸体，竟然诡异的失去了所有精华。
这就让叶成百思不得其解了。
“还真是。”
王路走了过去，检查一番后，皱起了眉毛。
丘凌风此时干脆装作什么都不知道。
他可不会傻乎乎的说出这件事情和他有关。
不过……
王路和叶成和玄冰蛇一番战斗，最后让他捡了便宜，他心里还是挺对不住两人的。
“不要管这些了，还是抓紧时间休息吧，这回留两人守夜。”
王路开口说道。
这一次丘凌风自告奋勇守起了夜，同时也是为了好好的了解自己的金手指——吞噬系统。
与他一起守夜的是叶成。
见其他人睡的差不多了，丘凌风就将心神放在了系统上。
吞噬系统，顾名思义，靠吞噬获得力量。
刚才丘凌风吞噬了玄冰蛇，修为一举突破到了通脉境三段，与叶成一个修为。

甚至还得到了一个冰封天眸的神通天赋。
神通天赋！
魔兽大都有神通天赋。
但是人族的话，只有极少数的武者能够领悟出来，武者的进攻手段基本上都是武技。
冰封天眸的效果也很给力。
能让丘凌风冰冻同修为目标三秒钟，其他修为的目标冰冻时间与其实力成反比。
是一个十分不错的底牌神通。
别看只是三秒钟，有时候就是这三秒钟，可以影响整个战局。
除此之外，丘凌风还得到了一个吞噬大礼包。
根据系统描述，这是丘凌风第一次吞噬魔兽奖励的礼包，算是新手礼包了。
没有犹豫，丘凌风选择了打开。
【叮咚，宿主打开吞噬大礼包。】
【恭喜宿主开启属性面板、随身空间、系统商城。】
嗯？
这就没了？
丘凌风又等了一会儿，发现没有其他动静之后，不禁吐槽道。
content_en:
As the sound of the system falls.
The aura of the Black Ice Snake's corpse instantly weakened, and its scales became dull.
"Captain, this black ice snake... seems to be weird, and its essence has almost disappeared."
Ye Cheng walked over to check the body of the Black Ice Snake, and found something abnormal about the body of the Black Ice Snake, and said.
The bodies of Warcraft can be sold for a good price, and some Warcraft even contain magic cores within their bodies, making them even more precious.
But right now, the corpse of the Warcraft Black Ice Snake has strangely lost all its essence.
This made Ye Chengbai puzzled.
"It's true."
Wang Lu walked over, checked it, and frowned.
Qiu Lingfeng simply pretended not to know anything at this time.
He would not foolishly say that this matter had something to do with him.
But...
Wang Lu and Ye Cheng fought with Xuan Bing Snake, and finally he got the advantage. He still felt sorry for the two of them.
"Don't worry about it. Let's take the time to rest. This time we will leave two people to watch the night."
Wang Lu said.
This time, Qiu Lingfeng volunteered to stay up all night, in order to better understand his golden finger - the Devouring System.
Standing vigil with him was Ye Cheng.
Seeing that the others were almost asleep, Qiu Lingfeng focused on the system.
The Devouring System, as the name suggests, relies on devouring to gain strength.
Just now, Qiu Lingfeng swallowed the Black Ice Snake, and his cultivation level broke through to the third level of Tongmai Realm in one fell swoop, and he was on the same level as Ye Cheng.
He even got the magical gift of Frozen Sky Eyes.
Supernatural talent!
Most Warcraft have magical talents.
But as for the human race, only a very small number of warriors can understand it. The offensive methods of warriors are basically martial arts.
The effect of Frozen Sky Eyes is also very powerful.
It allows Qiu Lingfeng to freeze fellow cultivators as targets for three seconds. The freezing time for targets with other cultivation levels is inversely proportional to their strength.
It's a very good trump card magical power.
Don't look at it as just three seconds, sometimes these three seconds can affect the entire battle.
In addition, Qiu Lingfeng also received a swallowing gift package.
According to the system description, this is the first time Qiu Lingfeng has swallowed the gift pack of World of Warcraft rewards, and it is considered a novice gift pack.
Without hesitation, Qiu Lingfeng chose to open it.
[Ding dong, the host opens the devouring gift package. 】
[Congratulations to the host for opening the property panel, portable space, and system mall. 】
Um?
Is this gone?
Qiu Lingfeng waited for a while, and after finding that there was no other movement, he couldn't help complaining.
